bugs.error_message: forms render as the text "null" in the login and create cards after attaching to an existing run
bugs.root_cause: buildFlow() replaced the flow's children, detaching the old cards that held the two forms; document.getElementById then returned null and el() appended it as text
bugs.fix: hold LOGIN_FORM, CREATE_FORM and RUN_BUTTON by reference at load (assets/app.js) instead of looking them up by id after a rebuild

bugs.error_message: error: used `assert!` to check that a value is empty (clippy::assert_is_empty)
bugs.root_cause: the Linux build host runs clippy 0.1.99, newer than the local one; the lint does not exist locally, so the local gate passed
bugs.fix: assert_eq!(x, Vec::<T>::new()) in src/util.rs and src/phases.rs; run the gate on the Linux build host before handing back

bugs.error_message: cargo deny: RUSTSEC-2024-0436 paste is unmaintained
bugs.fix: ratatui 0.30 (no paste); builds without code changes

bugs.error_message: secrets map: phantom token and audience tokens shown PENDING after the claim was released
bugs.root_cause: memory-only secrets fell back to the VM's observed presence, which is Pending when never observed
bugs.fix: in_memory(): Possible while live, Gone once the claim was bound and has ended, else Pending (src/secrets.rs)

bugs.error_message: Create card kept saying 'POST /v1/claims in flight' after the broker refused the claim; raw JSON in the note
bugs.root_cause: the renderer only knew 'claim present' or 'in flight'; a failed state was not a case
bugs.fix: brokerError() parses 'mediatore: <status> {json}'; the card, rail node and finish line show code, detail and a hint (REFUSAL_HINTS) (assets/app.js)

bugs.root_cause: used Session::default_path() directly; the CLI honours MEDIATORE_SESSION first
bugs.fix: engine::session_path(): MEDIATORE_SESSION, else the XDG default (src/engine.rs)

bugs.error_message: headless Chrome --virtual-time-budget never finishes on a page attached to a running run
bugs.root_cause: virtual time stalls with the open EventSource; not a page bug (a plain screenshot renders)
bugs.fix: screenshots without --virtual-time-budget, with --force-prefers-reduced-motion; replayed events (older than 3 s) refocus without animation

bugs.error_message: LOW_TIDE_WORKLOAD ignored in the web page; the broker kept refusing docker.io (unreachable_registry)
bugs.root_cause: the page restored the forms from localStorage over the server's defaults, so an old typed workload beat the environment and the config file
bugs.fix: no browser memory of the forms; the server's values (flag > env > config file) are the only source; old keys removed at load (assets/app.js)

bugs.error_message: TUI: stages 3-6 invisible; only two boxes drawn
bugs.root_cause: pending borders and dim text used the palette's DarkGray, which is the background colour in Solarized Dark
bugs.fix: explicit RGB colours DIM and GOOD (src/tui.rs); TestBackend tests assert every stage title is on screen

bugs.error_message: dist/low-tide-darwin-arm64 exits 137 (SIGKILL) right after make dist
bugs.root_cause: cp over the existing signed binary changed its pages under the kernel's cached code signature
bugs.fix: rm -f the target before cp in make dist (Makefile)

bugs.error_message: run step 'Guest attested, sandbox fetched' shown done while the guest never fetched its sandbox
bugs.root_cause: record.nodeId is set by the broker at bind, not by the guest; the label overclaimed
bugs.fix: renamed to 'Node identity on the record'; the guest's fetch moved into 'Guest fetched and built the sandbox' (its report is the first evidence) (src/phases.rs)

bugs.error_message: network graph's arrow landed on the middle gateway, implying it carried the tunnel
bugs.root_cause: with no gateway known, the arrow targeted the row's centre, which is a gateway
bugs.fix: unknown: the arrow meets a bracket over the whole row; known (seal.via): straight to that gateway (assets/app.js drawWires)

bugs.error_message: TUI: the workload could not be edited except at its end; no other sandbox create options; no buttons
bugs.root_cause: a single input string with push/pop only, one prompt at a time
bugs.fix: src/form.rs: login and create forms with every CLI option, a cursor, checkboxes, choices, buttons ([ Log in ] [ Quit ] / [ Run ] [ Cancel run ]), Ctrl-S, mouse clicks via hit rects; TestBackend tests

bugs.error_message: runs pile up at 'VM bound': each claim waits behind earlier ones
bugs.root_cause: Cancel and a new login only stopped Low Tide watching; the old AgentSandbox stayed queued for the pool's next VM
bugs.fix: Run::cancel_and_release(): stop watching, then DELETE /v1/claims/{name}; used by web Cancel, TUI Cancel run / c, and a new TUI login

bugs.error_message: live web-3d run: no gateway checks shown (no fuchsia tier, gateway edges dashed) though the broker logged them for the claim
bugs.root_cause: watch_egress took the claim uid from the POST /v1/claims answer, which is None until the broker creates the claim; an empty uid returned at once. The demo always has the uid, so it hid this.
bugs.fix: watch_egress reads the uid from the AgentSandbox's status.claimUid (the shared latest object) until it is known, then reads the broker log

bugs.error_message: Wired 3D animation jittery and slow, high CPU, during live runs with lots of output
bugs.root_cause: outputLine read the output pre's scroll geometry, appended one span, then set scrollTop, per line: two forced layouts of a growing pre per line. Bursts of pip/mkdocs output stalled frames up to 500 ms; the 50 ms dt clamp made the scene also run slow.
bugs.fix: Queue lines and flush once per frame (flushTerm in frame()) as one fragment with one scroll read and write; keep the latest 2000 spans (copy reads model.lines). Burst test: 18 fps / p95 350 ms -> 59 fps / p95 16.7 ms.

bugs.error_message: recess web: Ctrl-C does not stop the server while a Watch page is open
bugs.root_cause: axum's graceful shutdown waits for every connection to finish; the /api/watch server-sent event stream never ends, so the shutdown waited forever, and tokio's ctrl_c handler had replaced the default SIGINT so a second Ctrl-C did nothing
bugs.fix: an App.stopping watch channel set on Ctrl-C; both SSE streams take_until it; a fallback exits with 130 on a second Ctrl-C or after 5 s (src/web.rs)

bugs.error_message: AgentSandbox shows sheet 01 stamped "signed · you" before anyone signs in
bugs.root_cause: cli.js gained a global async function signedIn(near) for the Dex badge; agentsandbox.js already declares a global function signedIn() (the stamp animation). Classic scripts share one global scope, so the later declaration won and cli.js called the stamp animation on every page load.
bugs.fix: Renamed the cli.js function to showSignedInUser; web.rs test no_two_scripts_on_a_page_declare_the_same_name checks every page's scripts for shared top-level names.

bugs.error_message: Admin view stopped updating live (deleted gateways stayed on screen, 'live' still lit); a page reload showed the right state
bugs.root_cause: frame() asked for the next animation frame only as its last line, so any error in one frame ended the loop for good: the inbox of server changes was never applied again. The inbox was also spliced whole before applying, so one bad message lost its batch, and dirty was cleared before layout() ran, so a failed layout was never retried.
bugs.fix: theatre.js runFrames(step): asks for the next frame first, runs step in try/catch, logs a repeated error once. Both views start their loop through it. Admin applies each server change in its own try, and clears dirty only after layout succeeds.
